proof_attempt_summary: The run derived a generic source-augmentation criterion, explicit same-law witness machinery, an all-pairs flow procedure, and a pointwise exceptional-fiber recursion, then checked the load-bearing published fiber and rank sources. D0.5 judged the package incremental rather than field-level, and the validity gate found that reaching field would require a new observable-reconstruction, inference/stability, broader-query, or distributional-theory program rather than a bounded repair. A future strong-incremental version must still complete the D(C) support proof, make the Assumption-1 quantifiers explicit, narrow the exceptional all-pairs output, align the cited leaves, and rerender.
tldr: Under connected-set dependent errors and Assumption 1 on the base law, total-effect identification separates sharply from coefficient recovery. Generically, tau_xy is constant on the complete observational coefficient fiber exactly when adding x to the removable-ancestor sources does not increase vertex-disjoint path rank at any proper x-to-y path vertex. The result includes an all-pairs max-flow procedure and legal same-law counterfibers. At every exceptional coefficient point, a pointwise full-fiber transfer and rank-one reachable-span recursion decide exact constancy, return the identified value or a legal same-law witness, grow by at most one dimension per stage, and use O(n^4) dense exact arithmetic for rational inputs.
gap: The closest exact-model paper completely characterizes direct-coefficient fibers but does not determine which nonlinear functions of those coefficients, such as path-sum total effects, are invariant. Existing total-effect work is either a sufficient covariance-model decomposition or a complete theorem under the materially narrower explicit-latent lvLiNGAM model.
fill: Establish the source-augmentation iff criterion and its counterfiber, implement it for all pairs with one flow per vertex, prove exact pointwise constancy on arbitrary supplied product affine fibers, and document strict reconvergent examples beyond all-path coefficient recovery and TED plus a complete direct-effect oracle.
